name: Mach Connections
old_description: Mach Connections, a subsidiary of the Correct Craft family of companies, specializes in OEM panel production, hydro graphics, wire harness manufacturing, and battery cable assemblies. Acquired and rebranded in 2022, the company has rapidly gained recognition as a leader in the industry, providing high-quality products and exceptional customer service. Their team of experts possess extensive experience in the marine industry, dedicated to identifying and providing the most suitable electrical solutions for their clients. Boaters can rely on Mach Connections to ensure their boats remain connected and operate efficiently.
about:
Mach Connections is headquartered in Bowling Green, Florida, where it operates as a subsidiary of the Correct Craft family of companies. The current entity was formed in 2022 when the business was acquired and rebranded, focusing its efforts on marine electrical systems.

The shop delivers four core services: OEM panel production, hydro graphics application, wire harness manufacturing, and battery cable assembly. An in-house engineering group assists with custom panel design and harness specification, though the company does not publish facility dimensions, employee counts, or annual volumes.

Customers span the marine sector, including original equipment manufacturers that integrate Mach Connections’ panels and harnesses into new boats, as well as individual boaters seeking replacement or upgrade cable assemblies. The company’s marketing highlights its specialization in marine electrical solutions.

Leadership points to the team’s extensive marine-industry experience as its primary differentiator, coupled with a consultative approach that aims to identify the most suitable electrical solution for each application rather than offering off-the-shelf products alone.
